AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Establishment Planting Site? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Establishment Planting Site.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Selected Crop Management Practises? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Selected Crop Management Practises.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Selected Crop Management Practises.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Selected Crop Management Practises.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Trees.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Food Nutrients.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Food Nutrients.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Food Nutrients.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Food Nutrients.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products.

19. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals.

22. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
